long: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a landmark 3D action-adventure following Link across time to stop Ganondorf from seizing the Triforce. It introduced Z-targeting combat, context-sensitive controls, and ocarina-based music puzzles that became series staples. Set in the kingdom of Hyrule, it is frequently cited as one of the most influential games ever made.
